name: Travel MCP Server
description: MCP servers for travel: reward flights, Google Flights, Google Maps

MCP_TRANSPORT.description: Transport mode: stdio, sse, or streamable-http

TRAVEL_SERVER.description: Which server to run: travel-seats, travel-flights, or travel-maps

SEATS_AERO_API_KEY.description: Seats.aero Partner API key (required for travel-seats)

GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY.description: Google Maps API key (required for travel-maps)

FLIGHTS_RATE_LIMIT.description: Max requests/sec for Google Flights scraping (default: 0.5)

MAPS_RATE_LIMIT.description: Max requests/sec to Google Maps API (default: 10.0)
